HEADER: Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +14
DEFENSE: AC 22, touch 16, flat-footed 17 (+5 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)
Immune berserk, disease, poison, sleep, slow; Resist shadow 5, fire 10
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Powerful Charge (gore; 2d8+8), Pumpkin Head, Sweet Breath
3rd (DC 15) - Detonate III, Fira, Fire III, Slow, Summon Monster III [hedgehog pies only]
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 20, Con 20, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 14
Feats Combat Casting, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Toughness
Skills Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Climb +13, Intimidate +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Survival +14, Swim +16
SQ Spiny Defense, Summon Hedgehog Pie
SPECIAL ABILITIES: A hedgehog pie king can create a magical barrier around itself and its allies within 20 feet, granting Protect and Shell that lasts 5 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 25).

4/day, a hedgehog pie king can drop a pumpkin from the sky upon its foe within 15 feet from itself. The falling pumpkin must succeed at a range touch attack (+15) and deals extra damage based on the number of hit points the hedgehog pie king has lost from max. Pumpkin head deals 1 point of non-elemental damage to a target. This damage is increased by 1d4 for every 5 hit points missing to a maximum of 10d4. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

As a move action, a hedgehog pie king can roll itself up into a spiny ball. While rolled up, it gains a +3 enhancement bonus to its existing natural armor, and any creature attempting to grapple the hedgehog pie king takes 1d6 damage on making a grapple check. While rolled up, a hedgehog pie king cannot take an action other than leaving this state or casting a spell. The hedgehog pie king can leave this state as a move action.
A hedgehog pie king can cast Summon Monster III as a standard action if it would otherwise be slower, and summons 1d4+1 hedgehog pies when it summons hedgehog pies.

A hedgehog pie king blows a sweet smelling breath in a 15 foot cone. Creatures within the area of effect must make a Will save (DC 16) or be inflicted with the Sleep status for 1d6+1 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 23).
ECOLOGY: Organization court (1 accompanied by 2-10 hedgehog pies)

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Passive or toggleable special abilities that can be represented as buffs also create Foundry buff items.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
